source.license_note: Real upstream klauspost/compress optimization PR #293; measured-speedup task.

task.summary: Speed up DEFLATE decompression in the flate inner loop by removing the per-call moreBits closure, replacing the length-code branch ladder with a lookup table, and inlining huffSym with b/nb kept in local registers, without changing decoded output.
task.instructions: Optimize the flate package decompressor hot loop for speed WITHOUT changing behavior. The benchmark BenchmarkDecodeDigitsDefault1e6 measures it; existing tests must still pass.
task.acceptance_notes: Behavior preserved (go test passes); higher measured speedup is better. Do NOT edit any *_test.go.

code_fault.description: The flate decompressor inner loop uses a per-call moreBits closure, a long branch ladder to decode length codes, and a separate huffSym call, leaving f.b/f.nb in struct fields the compiler cannot keep in registers on the hot decode path.

ops_fault.description: CPU profile of flate decompression shows time spent in the decompressor inner loop: the moreBits closure, the length-code branch ladder, and the huffSym symbol lookup that repeatedly loads/stores f.b and f.nb from struct fields.
repair_keywords: decCodeToLen lookup table for length and extra bits
inline moreBits ReadByte into the loop

visible_context.issue_text: DEFLATE decompression via the flate package is slower than it needs to be: the decompressor inner loop pays for a per-call moreBits closure, a long switch ladder to compute match lengths, and a separate huffSym call whose f.b/f.nb accesses the compiler keeps in memory instead of registers.
error_logs: pprof: time concentrated in flate.(*decompressor) inner decode loop (moreBits + huffSym + length-code switch) during BenchmarkDecodeDigitsDefault1e6
visible_context.notes: Real upstream optimization; profiling diagnosis derived from the PR description. flate/inflate_gen.go is generated from the flate/gen_inflate.go template.
